params.body:
## Why

PR 480 made every lead a full card. Seen live with fifteen leads that is a page of cards; owner: "beter collapsen".

## What changed

`resources/views/worklist/widgets/4.blade.php` (Tailwind in the blade, no change to `refresh.css`, `ui.php`, `app.blade.php`):

- Each lead is one compact row: unread dot, name (semibold), vehicle (muted, truncated), the message as a one-line excerpt (`Str::squish`, ellipsis, muted), time right. One line at 1440; on a phone the excerpt wraps to a second line (a long vehicle name can push the time to its own line, so two to three).
- The row is a `<button>` with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`; Enter/Space toggle it natively, `focus-visible:ring-2 ring-brand-blue` for the keyboard. Tapping opens the card under it: full message (four lines, then "meer"/"minder"), tel: and mailto: links, the preference chip, the two "Bekijk" text links. Independent toggles; nothing opens by itself, unread leads keep their dot.
- Opening an unread row marks it read through the existing update route, without a reload (`markLeadRead(li)` reads `data-read-url` on the card, drops the dot, flips `.unread` to `.read` and the envelope button to "mark as unread"). That is what the eye did (R P1-3.11); the eye still calls `toggle(...)` with its original onclick and now goes through the same function. Caught during verification: the first version passed `this.$el` from the row's click, which is the button, not the card; it is `this.$root` now.
- The three icon actions are one set, placed by flex order: right of the row on `sm+` (mark read / mail / delete straight from the list), under the opened card on a phone (`:class="open ? 'flex' : 'hidden sm:flex'"`).
- Hooks kept: `#widget_fold_4`, `#lead-{id}`, `.read/.unread`, `.ui-lead-links`, all routes and onclicks. No new translation keys (the "meer"/"minder" keys from PR 480 are reused).

Rules P1-3.10, P1-3.11 and P1-3.12 in `31-p1-dagelijks-werk.md` describe the row, the opening and the links.

## Screenshots (local, demo dataset, 15 leads: 9 unread, 6 read, long and short messages)

`scratchpad/leads-widget/collapsed-1440.png`, `collapsed-1440-open.png`, `collapsed-390.png`, `collapsed-390-open.png`.

- 1440, collapsed: fifteen one-line rows in the half-width Leads card, dot / name / vehicle / excerpt with ellipsis / time, the three small icon buttons right of each row. Nothing scrolls inside the card.
- 1440, first row opened: the card shows the full message clamped at four lines with "meer", phone, e-mail, "via telefoon" chip, the two links; the row's dot is gone and the envelope shows open (marked read, no reload). The other rows stay one line.
- 390, collapsed: two lines per row (name + vehicle + time, then the excerpt), no icon buttons in the list, no horizontal scroll.
- 390, one row opened: message, contact line, the two links each 44 px, then the three icon buttons at the bottom of the card.

Note for local runs: the demo seeder writes `widgets.width = '6'` instead of a `col-*` class, which makes the column size to its content and the truncation useless; production rows carry `col-12 col-lg-6` (the test inserts the same). Screenshots were taken with the production classes.

## Tests

`WorklistPageTest` (rewritten: `test_a_lead_is_one_row_that_opens_to_the_question`, `test_the_links_under_a_lead_are_two_text_links_with_an_icon`), `LanguageParityTest`, `StylesheetSyntaxTest`, `CompiledViewsTest`, `AlpineExpressionTest`, `HandlerWiringTest`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `RulesIdentityTest`: 27 tests, 853 assertions, one failure that is not this change (`test_the_dialog_lists_every_worklist_as_one_row_with_a_named_switch`, the schema file seeds `widgets` with names like "Own stock" on my local database; passes on an empty table as in CI). `SmokeTest` worklists pages: OK (3 tests).
params.title: Worklists: leads collapse to one line each, open on tap
